mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credit_score_event ( user_id, reason_code, delta, score_after, description, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{reasonCode}, #{delta}, #{scoreAfter}, #{description}, #{occurredAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT credit_score_event_id, user_id, reason_code, delta, score_after, description, occurred_at FROM credit_score_event WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, credit_score_event_id DESC LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}
